possible_knowledge_delta: getComponentDetails and getComponentsByNames cannot receive name arguments through these native bindings; changing component spelling or repeating the call does not repair argument loss. acceptance_to_freeze_before_model_calls.normal_completion: Keep the original agent completion classification, rounds/time/output limits. No final-response truncation or loop exhaustion recast as normal completion.
task_quality: A persisted runnable parser must read all original relevant files and produce daily error totals; severity/record/date rules must be frozen against real log format before seeing agent output.
Independent expected totals must be frozen and kept outside all agent/updater contexts. Missing files, unexecuted parser or invented totals are unknown/fail, never core pass.

A persisted runnable webpage must display the verified daily results, a genuinely dynamic title and highlighted statistics cards. Inspect the generated artifact and its runtime; raw TSX snippets or claimed deployment are insufficient.
Execution, values, component/dependency integration, referenced output paths and final factual claims must agree. Partial completion cannot be promoted as full task quality.
acceptance_to_freeze_before_model_calls.TF_PE_ECS: Original five-first-valid judge protocol, raw TF/PE/ECS and actual artifacts remain separate; no invented weighted score.
acceptance_to_freeze_before_model_calls.retention: Reuse original task235 retention with exactly K0 for both methods. Completion, actual core quality and TF cannot decrease; unknown never passes.

conditional_schedule_design.pilot_gate: Changed completion and core counts each >=SP with at least one strict improvement, TF>=SP; retention completion/core/TF>=SP. This is a development gate only.

conditional_schedule_design.final_gate: In EACH independent block changed normal completion count>SP AND core count>SP, TF>=SP; retention completion/core/TF>=SP. Preserve all failures and costs. No pooling to hide a failed block or reruns until success.
